Cultural y Deportiva Leonesa, better known as Cultural Leonesa or La Cultural, is a Spanish football team based in León, in the autonomous community of Castile and Leon. Founded on 5 August 1923, it currently plays in Primera Federación – Group 1, holding home games at Estadio Reino de León, with a capacity of 13,346 seats.
